## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:区域租约模式的复审遗留 7 项落地:`lease:` 标签进 `ensure-pm-labels.sh`;复核席同账号例外写进复核席章程;删掉租约表无人读的「复核席」列;席线程「不读日志」与红检查读日志的冲突写明由子代理读;区签名第三位、在任 PM「会话」与表内会话两两互见三处措辞写清。
- 为什么改:PR 33777 达档复审留下的 nit(N3、N6–N8、N11–N13),按卡逐条处理;N14(读数四遇豁免卡是否往下读)两种读法会改变席位自退行为,按派发令不擅自选,留待裁定。
- 风险与回滚:只改席位读的规则文本和一个标签脚本,不碰产品代码和发布包;三份规则文件行数与上限持平(60/21/100);回滚即 revert。
- 先看:`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/area-lease.md`(N6/N7/N8/N11 四处与删掉的插队指针行),其次 `seat-lifecycle.md` L11,再次 `scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh` 新增的 `lease:` 段。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`,预期 area-lease.md 60/60、lanes/review.md 21/21、seat-lifecycle.md 100/100 全绿,无超 120 字节行。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(Tier S,达档契约复审 PASS 后由席位经队列落地);N14 的取舍由席位按决策流程处理。

## What changes

Review follow-ups of PR #33777 (records 6893242470, 6893494266, 6893759817), one commit per item:

- [x] **N3** `d3ea1d6c` — `scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh` gains a `lease:AREA` row: a `for A in A1 A2 A3 A4 A5 E1 E2 E2b` loop seeding the current lease table's eight pilot values (main repo only, colour `0052cc`, description 90 characters). The comment names the two area-lease.md lines as the family's readers and says the values MOVE when a lane re-cuts its table, the way the release-board loop moves its window. The eight objects exist today as GitHub's auto-created grey with an empty description (read `lease:A1`, `lease:E2b`); `--reconcile` aligns them.
- [x] **N6** `cf51d0eb` — `lanes/review.md`'s independence line now names the `area-lease.md` exception; `area-lease.md` says the maintainer's word goes in that review thread (该复核线程) instead of the unnamed 本线程.
- [x] **N7** `f8708dce` — the lease table's 复核席 column is deleted (measured first: no rule in `.claude/`, `docs/` or `scripts/` reads it; routing follows `contract-review.md` alone).
- [x] **N8** `d25a92af` — under the seat-thread no-log line: the red-check log read owed on a PR the seat lands (`platform-readings.md`) goes to a sub-agent, and one read satisfies both. `platform-readings.md` and `landing-operations.md` are untouched (zero hunk there). The added line is paid by deleting the `插队照 landing-operations.md 三因;⛔ 本文不改队列配置` pointer line. Surviving homes: the three front-jump reasons live in `landing-operations.md` (reached through the landing line's own pointer to that file) and in `lanes/queue.md`, which also reserves queue configuration.
- [x] **N11** `507a93eb` — the area session fills both the signature's third slot and `Session:` (the writing session, the precedent the second record named).
- [x] **N12 + N13** `324f14e5` — `seat-lifecycle.md` L11: 在任 PM 会话与其租约表会话两两互见, so the exemption is between sessions and pairwise across the whole group. To stay inside the 120-byte line budget the line drops 算 from 不算占席 and 读数 from 读数三、四 (the two reading lines sit directly above it).
- [ ] **N14** — not changed; a fork, put to the seat (see Acceptance notes). This is why the first line is `Part of`.

## Tests

No product code and no test file changes; no forced test edit. Gate readings below.

## Acceptance notes

**N14 — two readings change seat behaviour, so neither is picked here.** Reading four today: the session id of the newest CLOSED lane card carrying a same-seat `Claim:` (one sample, no skip clause; reading three, by contrast, skips the reader's own session). When that card's claim is exempt (a lease-table session), the letter leaves two readings:

- A: pass on to the next closed card whose same-seat claim is not exempt. Strictly more stand-downs: it catches a duplicate or recovery session that closed a card within the round when an area closed a newer one. Cost: in area mode most closed cards are areas', so the walk reads further back each fire. Zero-line edit to L10.
- B: read four as empty. Today's letter taken literally; fewer stand-downs; reading three still catches any foreign session active on an open card within the round.

A keeps 自退 conservative, and it changes what a seat does in that case, so by the dispatch order this is a fork for the seat's decision path, recommendation A.

Line budget: every touched rule file stays at its ceiling (area-lease.md 60, lanes/review.md 21, seat-lifecycle.md 100) with no line over 120 bytes; no ceiling row moves; no re-wrap was used to buy a line.
